ambient_events: A freight horn sounds a long way down the cut, and the bus windows hum with it.
One of the flag curtains is drawn back, then quietly drawn again.
The container ticks and settles as the night cools it.
Two people whisper an argument about a stolen blanket, decide it was theirs all along, and stop.
description: The second container, stacked on the first and turned a quarter round, so this floor points down the cut. Two portholes have been cut in the side with a gas axe and glazed with bus windows. A curtain of old flags hangs between each bunk and the next, which is as close to a private room as this building gets.
name: Hostel Takeover, third floor
